69274-chicago-and-the-old-northwest-1673.title: With A History Of Fort Dearborn
69274-chicago-and-the-old-northwest-1673.creator: Unknown

For while her citizens have striven worthily, during the three-quarters of a century that has passed since the birth of the modern city, to achieve greatness for her, it is none the less true that Nature has dealt kindly with Chicago, and is entitled to share with them the credit for the creation of the great metropolis of the present day.

arxiv-2008-04824.title: Anytime Guarantees for Reachability in Uncountable Markov Decision Processes
arxiv-2008-04824.creator: Kush Grover, Jan Křetínský, Tobias Meggendorfer, Maximilian Weininger
arxiv-2008-04824.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Kush Grover, Jan Křetínský, Tobias Meggendorfer, Maximilian Weininger. We consider the problem of approximating the reachability probabilities in Markov decision processes (MDP) with uncountable (continuous) state and action spaces. While there are algorithms that, for special classes of such MDP, provide a sequence of approximations converging to the true value in the limit, our aim is to obtain an algorithm with guarantees on the precision of the approximation. As this problem is undecidable in general, assumptions on the MDP are necessary.

arxiv-2111-07541.title: α \alpha knockout reaction as a new probe for α \alpha formation in α \alpha -decay nuclei
arxiv-2111-07541.creator: Kazuki Yoshida, Junki Tanaka
arxiv-2111-07541.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Kazuki Yoshida, Junki Tanaka. Background The α \alpha -decay phenomenon has been studied for more than a century. Its mechanism is simply explained by two factors, the α \alpha formation probability and the penetration process through the potential barrier. Purpose As an alternative to the α \alpha -decay lifetime measurement, we propose the proton-induced α \alpha knockout reaction, ( p p , p ​ α p\alpha ), as a new probe for the surface α \alpha formation probability of α \alpha -decay nuclei.

arxiv-2202-03098.creator: Minoru Wakimoto
arxiv-2202-03098.description: Abstract Abstract In this paper we study the characters of N=3 superconformal modules by using the Zwegers’ theory on modification of mock theta functions. 1 Introduction As it is known well, the N=3 superconformal algebra is constructed as the W-algebra associated to the affine superalgebra \widehat{B}(1,1)=\widehat{osp}(3|2) .

arxiv-2205-09208.creator: Mike Heddes mheddes@uci.edu, Igor Nunes igord@uci.edu, Pere Vergés pvergesb@uci.edu, Denis Kleyko denis.kleyko@ri.se, Danny Abraham dannya1@uci.edu, Tony Givargis givargis@uci.edu, Alexandru Nicolau nicolau@ics.uci.edu, Alexander Veidenbaum alexv@ics.uci.edu
arxiv-2205-09208.description: Abstract Hyperdimensional computing (HD), also known as vector symbolic architectures (VSA), is a framework for computing with distributed representations by exploiting properties of random high-dimensional vector spaces. The commitment of the scientific community to aggregate and disseminate research in this particularly multidisciplinary area has been fundamental for its advancement.

arxiv-2307-01283.title: Wavefunction tomography of topological dimer chains with long-range couplings
arxiv-2307-01283.creator: F. Pellerin, R. Houvenaghel, W. A. Coish, I. Carusotto, P. St-Jean
arxiv-2307-01283.description: Abstract The ability to tailor with a high accuracy the inter-site connectivity in a lattice is a crucial tool for realizing novel topological phases of matter. Here, we report the experimental realization of photonic dimer chains with long-range hopping terms of arbitrary strength and phase, providing a rich generalization of the celebrated Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model.

arxiv-2402-05821.title: Guided Evolution with Binary Discriminators for ML Program Search
arxiv-2402-05821.creator: John D. Co-Reyes, Yingjie Miao, George Tucker, Aleksandra Faust, Esteban RealGoogle DeepMind
arxiv-2402-05821.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by John D. Co-Reyes, Yingjie Miao, George Tucker, Aleksandra Faust, Esteban RealGoogle DeepMind. How to automatically design better machine learning programs is an open problem within AutoML. While evolution has been a popular tool to search for better ML programs, using learning itself to guide the search has been less successful and less understood on harder problems but has the promise to dramatically increase the speed and final performance of the optimization process.

arxiv-2409-02867.title: The Impact of Balancing Real and Synthetic Data on Accuracy and Fairness in Face Recognition
arxiv-2409-02867.creator: Andrea Atzori, Pietro Cosseddu, Gianni Fenu, Mirko Marras
arxiv-2409-02867.description: Abstract Over the recent years, the advancements in deep face recognition have fueled an increasing demand for large and diverse datasets. Nevertheless, the authentic data acquired to create those datasets is typically sourced from the web, which, in many cases, can lead to significant privacy issues due to the lack of explicit user consent.

arxiv-2505-12148.creator: A. García Muñoz
arxiv-2505-12148.description: Abstract Context. The He i line at 1.08 μ \mu m is a valuable tracer of atmospheric escape in exoplanet atmospheres. Aims. We expand past networks used to predict the absorbing He(2 S 3 {}^{3}S ) by including, firstly, processes that involve H 2 and some molecular ions and, secondly, the interaction of photoelectrons with the atmosphere. Methods.

pmc-10574635.title: A Detailed Comparative Analysis of the Structural Stability and Electron-Phonon Properties of ZrO2: Mechanisms of Water Adsorption on t-ZrO2 (101) and t-YSZ (101) Surfaces
pmc-10574635.creator: Dilshod D Nematov, Amondulloi S Burhonzoda, Kholmirzo T Kholmurodov, Andriy I Lyubchyk, Sergiy I Lyubchyk, J Karl Johnson
pmc-10574635.description: In this study, we considered the structural stability, electronic properties, and phonon dispersion of the cubic (c-ZrO2), tetragonal (t-ZrO2), and monoclinic (m-ZrO2) phases of ZrO2. We found that the monoclinic phase of zirconium dioxide is the most stable among the three phases in terms of total energy, lowest enthalpy, highest entropy, and other thermodynamic properties.

pmc-11403802.title: Ulnar lengthening for children with forearm deformity from hereditary multiple exostoses: a retrospective study from a tertiary medical center
pmc-11403802.creator: Shuo Wang, Bomansaan Herman, Yiheng Wu, Ming Lei, Blessing Mutasa, Pan Hong, Jin Li
pmc-11403802.description: BackgroundPatients with hereditary multiple exostosis (HME) usually present with forearm deformity with or without radial head dislocation. Ulna lengthening has been proposed to address this condition. Exostosis resection plus ulna lengthening has been adopted in our hospital since 2008, and patients with this condition were retrospectively reviewed.

pmc-11511165.title: A Self-Powered Wireless Temperature Sensor Platform for Foot Ulceration Monitoring
pmc-11511165.creator: Joseph Agyemang Duah, Kye-Shin Lee, Byung-Gyu Kim, Klaus Moessner
pmc-11511165.description: This work describes a self-powered wireless temperature sensor platform that can be used for foot ulceration monitoring for diabetic patients. The proposed self-powered sensor platform consists of a piezoelectric bimorph, a power conditioning circuit, a temperature sensor readout circuit, and a wireless module.

pmc-12409458.title: Shared decision-making for early-stage breast cancer treatment: An evolutionary concept analysis
pmc-12409458.creator: Heemin Chae, Hee-Ju Ji, Hyunjung Moon, Yeongeun Lee, Youn-Jung Son
pmc-12409458.description: ObjectiveThe lack of a clear and unified definition of shared decision-making (SDM) may hinder its effective application in oncology care. This study aims to clarify the concept of SDM specifically in the context of early-stage breast cancer treatment through an evolutionary concept analysis.

pmc-12469719.title: Drivers of and Barriers to Behavioural Change to Support Public Health and Social Wellbeing in Mbire District, Zimbabwe
pmc-12469719.creator: Davison Munodawafa, Pepukai Manjeru, Lioyd Goronga
pmc-12469719.description: Foundational behaviours across health, education, sanitation, and energy use remain suboptimal in Mbire District, Zimbabwe. This qualitative formative study examined drivers of and barriers to five priority behaviours: birth notification and registration (BNR), exclusive breastfeeding (EBF), early childhood development education (ECDE), open-defecation-free (ODF) practices, and efficient use of energy (EUE).

pmc-12535894.title: Association between systemic immune-inflammation index, systemic inflammation response index, and adverse outcomes in aneurysmal subarachnoid hemorrhage: a meta-analysis
pmc-12535894.creator: Yihong Hao, Jianfang Zhao, Jie Han, Dajiang Hao
pmc-12535894.description: PurposeThis systematic review seeks to explore the link of the systemic immune-inflammation index (SII) and systemic inflammation response index (SIRI), to adverse outcomes (AOs) in aneurysmal subarachnoid hemorrhage (aSAH). The findings may provide scientific evidence to enable the timely identification of patients at high risk and guide the formulation of personalized treatment strategies.

pmc-12691398.title: Effects of MSTN Gene Knockout on Growth Performance and Muscle Transcriptome in Chinese Merino Sheep (Xinjiang Type)
pmc-12691398.creator: Li Zhang, Pengfei Li, Xu Wang, Menghua Kong, Weiwei Wu, Wenxin Zheng, Maria Luisa Dettori
pmc-12691398.description: Simple SummaryMyostatin (MSTN) is a key regulator of muscle development in animals, and its knockout has been shown to significantly enhance growth performance. In this study, MSTN knockout Chinese Merino sheep (Xinjiang type) were used to assess the effects of MSTN deletion on growth performance and the underlying molecular mechanisms.

pmc-12837675.title: Exploring the Relationship Between Electronic Device Use and Psychological Dimensions of Procrastination in University Students
pmc-12837675.creator: María Salguero-Pazos, Salvador Reyes-de-Cózar
pmc-12837675.description: This study examines the relationship between electronic device use and psychological dimensions of procrastination in university students. The main objectives were to identify screen usage habits, explore their association with key psychological factors, and determine whether these factors predict perceived procrastination.

pmc-12860774.title: Creativity and transition to bipolar disorder: a prospective analysis from the early-bipolife study
pmc-12860774.creator: Elisabeth Michaelis, Michael Bauer, Andreas Bechdolf, Felix Bermpohl, Christina Berndt, Kyra L. Bröckel-Bundt, Eva Burkhardt, Christoph U. Correll, Udo Dannlowski, Irina Falkenberg, Andreas J. Fallgatter, Paolo Fusar-Poli, Sarina Hadji, Andreas Jansen, Georg Juckel, Tilo Kircher, Sarah Kittel-Schnei
pmc-12860774.description: BackgroundBipolar disorders (BD) are severe mental illnesses with recurrent depressive and (hypo-)manic episodes and a chronic course. While anecdotal and cross-sectional studies suggest a link between BD and creativity, longitudinal evidence is limited. This study investigates the role of creativity in individuals with varying risk for developing BD, using data from the multicenter, prospective Early-BipoLife study.

pmc-13471188.title: From training to practice: a longitudinal study on the retention and career entry of young general practitioners in Czechia
pmc-13471188.creator: Luděk Šídlo, Jan Bělobrádek, Tom Philipp
pmc-13471188.description: BackgroundThe location of postgraduate training is considered a key determinant for the future practice location of primary care physicians. This study evaluates the effectiveness of the GP training program in Czechia, focusing on the spatial and temporal links between the place of training and subsequent career entry.

pmc-13678354.title: Genome-scale metabolic modeling-driven design of synbiotics for methane mitigation and quality improvement in fermented total mixed ration
pmc-13678354.creator: Tae-Yong Kim, Gayeon Seo, Hyung-pil Jun, Myunghoo Kim, Jong Nam Kim
pmc-13678354.description: Methane is a major greenhouse gas with a global warming potential 28 times greater than that of carbon dioxide, making reduction of livestock emissions a critical challenge. Current mitigation strategies, such as feed management, chemical additives, and algae supplementation, face limitations related to safety, supply instability, and economic feasibility.
